description: One malformed draft raises TodoError and aborts the entire finding sync, blocking every valid draft behind it; the create-time template's placeholder body fails the sync validator if landed unedited. Sync should skip+report malformed drafts and exit nonzero without blocking the rest; template should validate or create should warn.

work_units.evidence: per-draft isolation in sync_drafts (skip invalid with warning, exit 2, land valids), create_draft warns on placeholder via stderr; tests 15 pass
work_units.summary: Isolate per-draft failures + template/validator coherence + tests
